prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1320; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with symptoms consistent with concussion, including headache, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Three visits were completed over the treatment period. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the concussion diagnosis. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient's history. Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for an injury of this type, with symptoms improving gradually under conservative care including rest, graded return to activity, and symptom monitoring. At this stage, it is not yet clear whether the injury is entirely attributable to this crash, and further follow-up will help clarify causation. Billing records reflect a single charge for each visit with no repeated or duplicate entries. Plan: continue symptom tracking, reassess at next scheduled follow-up, and refer for neuropsychological testing if symptoms persist.
